title: Nine Lines and One Bill
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：architect　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 architect 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 an ① architect came to the village and drew nine lines on a page, and my grandfather said that was all he did. The ② architect, meaning the man and not the drawings, stayed four days and left a bill; an architect, my grandmother said, is somebody who is paid for the part you cannot see. My grandfather said nine lines was nine more than he needed, and the bill was nine times the lines.

Every ③ architect my father ever met asked the same first question, and none of them waited for the answer. Their ④ architect wanted the windows on the north, and my mother wanted them on the south, and the house has both; an architect, my father said, is a person who settles an argument by drawing it. He said the drawing settles nothing, but everybody stops shouting.

My uncle said the ⑤ architect of the whole business was my grandmother, meaning the cause and not the profession. The ⑥ architect, meaning the profession and not the person, is nine parts listening and one part paper, my father said; an architect, he said, is the only tradesman who is paid before anything exists. My uncle said that is also true of prophets, and my mother told him to be quiet.

By 1971 the ⑦ architect's drawings had been changed nine times and the house had not been started. The ⑧ architect came back in March and stood in the mud for an hour and said nothing; an architect, my mother said, is somebody who can look at a field and be unhappy in it. He said the unhappiness is the work, and the house is only what is left over.

The ⑨ architect I remember is the one who drew the nine lines, who never saw the house built and did not ask to. An ⑩ architect, my father said in 1979, is the only person who is judged by a building he will never live in; every architect, he said, is writing a letter to a family he has not met.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 建筑师（一个人）
B. n. 建筑师（指人本身，而非图纸）
C. n. 建筑师（指这个职业、这门行当）
D. n. 缔造者；造成某事的人（比喻义）
F. n. 建筑师（家里受聘的那一位）
G. n. 建筑师（抽象总称；泛指这类人）

items.q: an architect came to the village
The architect, meaning the man and not the drawings
Every architect my father ever met
the architect of the whole business
The architect came back in March
An architect, my father said in 1979

answers.why: architect 意为“建筑师”，1969 年有一位建筑师来到村里，在一页纸上画了九条线。
architect 指“人本身，而非图纸”，那位建筑师待了四天，留下一张账单。
architects 意为“建筑师们”，父亲见过的每一位建筑师开口都问同一个问题，而且没人等答案。
architect 指家里受聘的那一位，他们的建筑师想让窗子朝北，母亲想让窗子朝南，房子最后两边都有。
architect 为比喻义，意为“缔造者、造成某事的人”，叔叔说整件事的肇始者是祖母。
architect 指“这个职业、这门行当”，与具体的人相对，是九分倾听加一分图纸。
architect 作定语，意为“建筑师的”，到 1971 年建筑师的图纸改了九次，房子还没动工。
architect 意为“建筑师”，那位建筑师三月回来，在泥地里站了一个钟头，什么也没说。
architect 意为“建筑师”，我记得的是画了那九条线的人，他没看到房子建成，也没要求看。
architect 为抽象总称，泛指“建筑师这类人”，父亲说建筑师是唯一被一座自己永远不会住的房子评判的人。
